description: This file initializes the React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the React root and wraps the App component within React.StrictMode to help identify potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node for rendering into the DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the initialized root.
